title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 05 JULY 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 04 July 2026 Several spells of showers will occur in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central hills, Northern, North-central and North-western provinces and in Rathnapura, Hambantota and Trincomalee districts.
